name: demark_sequential_5s
author: adapted from claude-4.6-opus-agent-3
thesis: Tom DeMark's TD Sequential identifies trend exhaustion by counting consecutive bars that close higher (or lower) than the close 4 bars earlier. A 'setup' phase counts 1-9; a completed 9-count signals potential exhaustion. This is followed by a 'countdown' phase (13-count) for stronger confirmation. On 1-min Indian intraday charts, the 9-count setup identifies micro-trend exhaustion points where momentum is about to reverse. The inefficiency exists because: (1) TD Sequential is complex to implement correctly (many rules for perfection, recycling, and qualification), (2) most Indian traders use simple RSI overbought/oversold instead of the more precise TD Sequential counting, (3) the 4-bar lookback comparison filters out noise better than 1-bar momentum indicators. The signal is contrarian — we fade the trend at the 9-count completion.
mechanism: Institutional order flow arrives in bursts via algorithmic execution (TWAP/VWAP slicing), creating persistent directional pressure over 30-120 seconds. Retail and smaller participants follow the initial move, extending momentum before liquidity absorbs the flow and the order book rebalances.

indicators.name: td_buy_setup
indicators.formula: consecutive count of bars where close < close[4]. Count resets on close >= close[4]. Signal on count == 9.

indicators.name: td_sell_setup
indicators.formula: consecutive count of bars where close > close[4]. Count resets on close <= close[4]. Signal on count == 9.

indicators.name: td_perfection_buy
indicators.formula: 1 if low of bar 8 or 9 <= low of bar 6 (DeMark perfection rule for buy setup)

indicators.name: td_perfection_sell
indicators.formula: 1 if high of bar 8 or 9 >= high of bar 6

conditions: td_buy_setup == 9 (9 consecutive bars closing below close[4] — downtrend exhaustion)
close > low of setup bar 9 (first sign of bounce)

exit.signal_exit: close resumes the previous trend (close < close[4] again for a buy setup entry)

filters.vix_filter: India_VIX < 22 (perfected setups are more reliable in moderate vol)
filters.volume_filter: declining volume on the last 3 bars of the setup (confirms exhaustion)

weaknesses: The 4-bar comparison offset on 1-min charts means setups complete in minimum 9 minutes. On strong trend days, the trend continues well beyond the 9-count, hitting stops.
TD Sequential has many nuanced rules (recycling, qualifier, TDST levels) that are difficult to implement correctly. Partial implementation may degrade signal quality.
Contrarian signals in strong trends are inherently risky — 'catching falling knives' is the primary failure mode, and on trend days this strategy will underperform badly.
prior_art: DeMark (1994) 'The New Science of Technical Analysis'. DeMark (1997) 'New Market Timing Techniques'. Bloomberg's DeMark indicators (TD Sequential, TD Combo) are available on the Bloomberg terminal. In India, TD Sequential is used by some proprietary trading desks in Mumbai.
adaptation_notes: Converted from 1min to 5s bars. Lookback multiplier: 12x. Adaptations: timeframe scaling to 5-second candles; signal conversion from individual stock to NIFTY/BANKNIFTY index; lookback period scaling for 5-second bars. Stop/target calibrated for options point-based exits. Universe narrowed to NIFTY index.
